content: Severus Architecture: Selected Tauri v2 (Rust backend + React frontend) for local speed, native OS window controls, zero bloat, and low latency over web-only or heavy Electron.
Brand Transition: Evolved from 'Leavian Visuals' to 'Code x Create' / 'Focal Stack' to integrate software engineering and creative technology under one umbrella.
Relational Data Layer: Adopted PostgreSQL and Supabase over NoSQL alternatives for structured schemas, relational integrity, and robust Row Level Security.
